_about: Optional pronunciation profiles. None of these is treated as correct; they are hooks so a writer can analyze a verse the way they actually say it. Profiles compose: config phonetics.dialect may be a single name or a list of names applied in order.

none.description: No substitutions. Uses the dictionary or heuristic pronunciation as found.

cot_caught_merger.description: AO and AA are heard as the same vowel.

pin_pen_merger.description: EH before a nasal is heard as IH (pen sounds like pin).

non_rhotic.description: R after a vowel is not pronounced; ER is heard as a mid central vowel.

th_stopping.description: TH and DH are pronounced as stops T and D.

g_dropping.description: Unstressed final -ing ends in N instead of NG.
